title: Recovery Record Allowance at the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Tier Review
content:
**Risk standard — Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan tier review: the recovery-count allowance.**

The recovery-count allowance rests on the paydays whose period close line carries a pay date in the last twelve months and on the shortfalls carrying a pay date in the last twelve months, counted by method:

- when no such shortfall stands, or every one of them carries the reason deduction not taken, the count is the number of those paydays, a deduction the employer did not take never counting against the worker;
- when at least one stands, none of them was booked without a carryforward payday and at least one carries another reason, the count is the number of those paydays less the number of those shortfalls;
- otherwise the count is zero, which allows only Paystride Access Starter.

A count of 16 or more allows Paystride Access Premier Plus, 10 to 15 Paystride Access Premier, 6 to 9 Paystride Access Preferred, 4 or 5 Paystride Access Plus, 2 or 3 Paystride Access Standard, and fewer than 2 only Paystride Access Starter.

A record falls in the last N months when fewer than N whole months separate its date from today, whole months being the difference in calendar months less one when today's day of the month is smaller than that date's.

## Method by shortfall record (twelve months)

| Shortfalls in the last twelve months | Count |
|---|---|
| none, or every one with reason deduction not taken | the number of paydays |
| one or more, every one carried to a later payday, at least one with another reason | paydays less shortfalls |
| any other case: at least one with another reason and at least one booked without a carryforward payday | zero |

## Count and allowance

| Count | Highest tier allowed |
|---|---|
| 16 or more | Paystride Access Premier Plus |
| 10 to 15 | Paystride Access Premier |
| 6 to 9 | Paystride Access Preferred |
| 4 or 5 | Paystride Access Plus |
| 2 or 3 | Paystride Access Standard |
| 0 or 1 | Paystride Access Starter only |

## Hypothetical cases (eleven paydays closed in the last twelve months)

- No shortfall: count 11, allowing Paystride Access Premier.
- Two shortfalls, both with reason deduction not taken: count 11, Paystride Access Premier.
- Two shortfalls, both carried, one with reason net pay insufficient: count 11 less 2, 9, allowing Paystride Access Preferred.
- Two shortfalls, one with reason net pay insufficient carried, the other with reason employment ended and not carried: count zero, Paystride Access Starter only.

*Window boundary:* with today on the 14th of a month, a pay date on the 15th of the same month a year earlier is 12 calendar months back less one, 11 whole months, and falls in the last twelve months; a pay date on the 14th of that month is 12 whole months back and does not.
